Job description
Position: Commercial Housekeeper
Type: Full-time
Salary: AUD 68,000/year
Employer: BLUE WHALE SOLUTIONS PTY LTD
Location: PO Box 495 Alice Springs NT, 0870 Australia

About us:
BLUE WHALE SOLUTIONS PTY LTD provides commercial services in Alice Springs & Tennant Creek, NT. We start by asking what you need, rather than just giving you a rate sheet. This way, you can be assured you get the service you need at the right price and quality level. Offering tailored solutions to meet the unique needs of each client. Our highly trained staff utilise advanced techniques, eco-friendly products, and state-of-the-art equipment to ensure thorough and efficient cleaning. 

Position Available:
We are hiring full-time Commercial Housekeepers. We need reliable, motivated, and detail-oriented people. We offer stable work, a supportive team, and room to grow. We value a strong work ethic, dependability, and high cleaning standards.

Responsibilities:
1.	Perform regular and deep cleaning for offices, industrial sites, and NDIS participants
2.	Conduct end-of-lease cleaning to meet landlord and lease requirements
3.	Deliver post-construction cleaning to remove dust and debris
4.	Provide carpet cleaning to remove stains, dirt, and odours
5.	Vacuum, mop, dust, sanitise bathrooms, and clean kitchens
6.	Empty bins and replenish supplies as needed
7.	Identify and report maintenance issues or damages
8.	Travel to multiple job sites in Alice Springs, Tennant Creek, and surrounding areas
9.	Use eco-friendly products and equipment, following safety standards
10.	Communicate professionally with clients and team members

Requirements:
1. AQF Certificate I or compulsory secondary education, plus one year of relevant experience.
2. Prior involvement in maintaining cleanliness across commercial premises.
3. Australian Citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.

What we offer:
1. Competitive salary: AUD$68,000 per year.
2. Opportunities for growth and development.

Base pay
AUD$68,000

Job Title: Carpenter / Formwork 
Job Type: Full-Time 

About Us:   FG NSW Pty Ltd is a leading construction company specializing in high-quality 
residential and commercial projects. We are committed to excellence and innovation in every 
project we undertake.  

Job Description: We are seeking a skilled and experienced Carpenter/Formwork to join our 
dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in carpentry and a passion for 
building and repairing wooden structures and fixtures. You will work on a variety of projects, 
from constructing frameworks to managing team members, ordering materials making sure that 
all tasks are completed by allocated time frame.  

Key Responsibilities: 
•	Read and interpret blueprints, drawings, and sketches to understand project 
requirements. 
•	Take precise measurements and calculate the size and number of materials needed. 
•	Cut, shape, and smooth lumber and other materials (e.g., fiberglass) according to 
measurements. 
•	A tradesperson who has enough tools to complete any carpentry task at hand. 
•	Complete high-quality work in an appropriate timeframe while being able to delight 
clients. 
•	Inspect and replace damaged framework or other structures and fixtures. 
•	Installing the subfloor and floorboards, and confirming the accuracy of the structures 
•	Construct and install building frameworks, including walls, floors, and doorframes. 
•	Collaborate with other construction professionals to ensure project specifications are 
met. 
•	Follow all safety guidelines and protocols to ensure a safe working environment. 

Minimum Qualifications/Experience 
•	Minimum Cert 3 in carpentry /Formwork:  
•	Intermediate level; 5-8 years of site experience. 
•	Expert level: 15 years of site experience.  
•	Proven experience as a carpenter. 
•	Hands-on experience with carpentry materials and tools. 
•	Excellent understanding of carpentry techniques and methods of installation and 
construction. 
•	Ability to read technical documents and drawings, plans. 
•	Good physical condition and endurance. 
•	Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills. 
•	Good communication and teamwork abilities.

Applications open on 7 July 2026 and close on 6 August 2026

About the Company

Aggreko Australia Pty Ltd (formerly Aggreko Generator Rentals Pty Ltd) is a provider of flexible power generation solutions in Australia and the Pacific. It maintains global leadership in the temporary power generation marketplace by offering innovative rental solutions. Aggreko is a major player in the global power market. Aggreko has an established record of working with businesses to improve their outputs, manage power demands and plan for emergencies. Our specialised technology is critical to the operations of several global businesses, and we have continued to rapidly grow across the mining, construction and emergency service sector.

Position Description

We are seeking a dedicated Project Support Technician- Mechanical to join our team on a full-time basis. In this role you will be responsible for the following:

Provide product support to all ongoing Projects and new installs by way of operator relief, preventative maintenance, site repairs and commissioning.
Assist in new Installations, including commissioning, operating and training other staff of best practices.
Training of Power Station Operators in Aggreko maintenance and quality standards.
Timely and effectively carry out; internal maintenance and repairs, customer site installations / removals.
Carry out effective troubleshooting to minimise downtime and unnecessary repair costs
Carry out all electrical and mechanical repairs and checking of company assets in accordance with the company's policy.
Maintenance & troubleshooting of all hire fleet assets to ensure we receive the best possible returns on expenditure.

About You

To be successful in obtaining this role, you will have :
Proven experience in a similar role
Relevant trade qualification
Exceptional communication skills.
Strong customer focus.
Ability to work under pressure and make deadlines.
Planning, problem solving and coordination skills.
Ability to work unsupervised at times.

About the Role

We are seeking a skilled Carpenter / Cabinet Maker to join our team on a full-time basis. The successful candidate will be responsible for carrying out cabinetry, installation, repair, and maintenance works within residential properties managed by the company.

The role will focus on light kitchen upgrades, cabinet installation, shelving, storage units, furniture installation, doors, trims, internal fittings, minor repairs, and property improvement works required to prepare and maintain co-living houses.

Key Duties and Responsibilities

The successful candidate will be responsible for:

? ?Measuring, cutting, assembling, and installing timber, laminate, flat-pack, and prefabricated cabinetry components.
? ?Installing and adjusting kitchen cabinets, benchtops, cupboard doors, handles, hinges, drawers, shelving, wardrobes, storage units, and internal fittings.
? ?Completing light kitchen renovation works, including cabinet replacement, fitting adjustments, repairs, and installation of storage solutions.
? ?Installing and repairing doors, skirting boards, architraves, trims, shelves, fixtures, and fittings.
? ?Assembling and installing furniture and built-in storage for rooms and common areas.
? ?Repairing or replacing damaged cabinetry, timber fittings, doors, shelving, and fixtures.
? ?Reading and interpreting measurements, job instructions, product specifications, and site requirements.
? ?Selecting appropriate materials, tools, fixings, and methods for each job.
? ?Supporting property setup works in company-managed co-living properties.
? ?Ensuring all work is completed safely, neatly, and to a professional standard.
? ?Coordinating with maintenance coordinators, painters, cleaners, suppliers, and other trades where required.
? ?Maintaining tools, equipment, and work areas in a safe and organised condition.
? ?Reporting job progress, materials used, and any site issues to management.
? ?Complying with workplace health and safety requirements and company procedures.
Skills and Experience Required

The successful candidate must have:

? ?Minimum 1 year of full-time relevant experience as a Carpenter, Cabinet Maker, Joiner, or similar role, or equivalent pro-rata part-time experience.
? ?Experience with kitchen cabinetry, cabinet installation, furniture installation, shelving, timber repairs, internal fittings, or residential carpentry works.
? ?Ability to measure, cut, assemble, and install cabinetry and timber components accurately.
? ?Ability to use carpentry and cabinetry tools and equipment safely.
? ?Good understanding of residential property setup, repairs, and maintenance requirements.
? ?Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
? ?Strong attention to detail and ability to complete work to a high standard.
? ?Good communication and time management skills.
? ?White Card or willingness to obtain one.
? ?Relevant trade qualification, Certificate III, or Recognition of Prior Learning in Carpentry or Cabinet Making will be highly regarded.

Desirable
?Experience working in residential maintenance, light renovations, kitchen upgrades, property setups, or accommodation-related environments.
?Experience installing kitchens, cabinets, wardrobes, shelving, doors, trims, and furniture.
?Driver’s licence and ability to travel between company-managed properties.
?Ability to coordinate with suppliers and other trades on-site.
